markdown.markdown: ```python BoxModelSpec(name) ``` Declarative specification for simple ODE box models. A ``BoxModelSpec`` stores state names, parameter defaults, optional inputs, diagnostics, and either: - explicit callable tendencies registered via :meth:`register_tendency` / :meth:`register_relations`, or - an automatic box network assembled from volumes, reciprocal exchange, and directed transport terms ## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters} [**name**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation} : Model name used as the default ``var_name`` of the produced ``GenericBoxModel``. ## Notes {.doc-section .doc-section-notes} Call :meth:`validate` (or :meth:`make_boxmodel`) before integrating. Validation checks that every state variable has a tendency relation (explicit mode) or a registered volume (automatic mode). ## See also {.doc-section .doc-section-see-also} GenericBoxModel : The ``CCModel`` subclass produced by [](:meth:`make_boxmodel`). BoxModelContext : Evaluation context passed to callable tendencies. ## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples} Minimal explicit one-box relaxation model: ```python import climatecritters as cc from climatecritters.model_critters.box_model import BoxModelSpec spec = BoxModelSpec("relaxation") spec.register_state_variables(["x"]) spec.register_parameters(tau=10.0, x_eq=1.0) spec.register_tendency( "x", lambda ctx: (ctx.param("x_eq") - ctx["x"]) / ctx.param("tau") ) model = spec.make_boxmodel() output = model.integrate(t_span=(0, 100), y0=[0.0], method='RK45') ``` Automatic two-box exchange model: ```python spec = BoxModelSpec("exchange") spec.register_state_variables(["A", "S"]) spec.register_box_volumes(A=1.0, S=50.0) spec.register_exchange("A", "S", 0.2) model = spec.make_boxmodel() ``` ## Methods | Name | Description | | --- | --- | | [make_model](#climatecritters.BoxModelSpec.make_model) | Instantiate a :class:`GenericBoxModel` from this spec. | | [register_box_volumes](#climatecritters.BoxModelSpec.register_box_volumes) | Register explicit box volumes for automatic network models. | | [register_diagnostic](#climatecritters.BoxModelSpec.register_diagnostic) | Register a callable diagnostic evaluated from solved history. | | [register_diagnostic_variables](#climatecritters.BoxModelSpec.register_diagnostic_variables) | Register diagnostic variable names. | | [register_exchange](#climatecritters.BoxModelSpec.register_exchange) | Register a reciprocal concentration-gradient exchange pathway. | | [register_input](#climatecritters.BoxModelSpec.register_input) | Register a prescribed input channel. | | [register_loss](#climatecritters.BoxModelSpec.register_loss) | Register a first-order loss coefficient for a box. | | [register_parameters](#climatecritters.BoxModelSpec.register_parameters) | Register default parameter values. | | [register_relations](#climatecritters.BoxModelSpec.register_relations) | Register multiple callable tendencies at once. | | [register_source](#climatecritters.BoxModelSpec.register_source) | Register an external source term for a box in automatic networks. | | [register_state_variables](#climatecritters.BoxModelSpec.register_state_variables) | Register prognostic state variables in integration order. | | [register_tendency](#climatecritters.BoxModelSpec.register_tendency) | Register a callable tendency for one state variable. | | [register_transport](#climatecritters.BoxModelSpec.register_transport) | Register a directed transport pathway. | | [validate](#climatecritters.BoxModelSpec.validate) | Validate that the spec is internally consistent. | ### make_model { #climatecritters.BoxModelSpec.make_model } ```python BoxModelSpec.make_model(var_name=None, **parameter_overrides) ``` Instantiate a :class:`GenericBoxModel` from this spec. ### register_box_volumes { #climatecritters.BoxModelSpec.register_box_volumes } ```python BoxModelSpec.register_box_volumes(**volumes) ``` Register explicit box volumes for automatic network models. #### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters} [**volumes**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[dict](`dict`)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [{}]{.parameter-default} : Mapping from box name to box volume. These are stored internally as parameters named ``V__``. ### register_diagnostic { #climatecritters.BoxModelSpec.register_diagnostic } ```python BoxModelSpec.register_diagnostic(name, relation) ``` Register a callable diagnostic evaluated from solved history. ### register_diagnostic_variables { #climatecritters.BoxModelSpec.register_diagnostic_variables } ```python BoxModelSpec.register_diagnostic_variables(names) ``` Register diagnostic variable names. ### register_exchange { #climatecritters.BoxModelSpec.register_exchange } ```python BoxModelSpec.register_exchange(left, right, rate, rate_param=None) ``` Register a reciprocal concentration-gradient exchange pathway. The flux is computed as ``rate * (C_left - C_right)`` and applied with equal magnitude and opposite sign to the two boxes. ### register_input { #climatecritters.BoxModelSpec.register_input } ```python BoxModelSpec.register_input(name, fallback_param=None) ``` Register a prescribed input channel. #### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters} [**name**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation} : Input name used by ``ctx.input(name)``. [**fallback_param**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`) or None]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [None]{.parameter-default} : Parameter name to use when the model has no ``forcing`` object. ### register_loss { #climatecritters.BoxModelSpec.register_loss } ```python BoxModelSpec.register_loss(box, value=0.0) ``` Register a first-order loss coefficient for a box. In automatic networks the tendency contribution is ``-loss__box * box_inventory``. ### register_parameters { #climatecritters.BoxModelSpec.register_parameters } ```python BoxModelSpec.register_parameters(**parameters) ``` Register default parameter values. Values may be constants, callables, or ``Forcing``-like objects compatible with ``CCModel.get_param``. ### register_relations { #climatecritters.BoxModelSpec.register_relations } ```python BoxModelSpec.register_relations(relations) ``` Register multiple callable tendencies at once. ### register_source { #climatecritters.BoxModelSpec.register_source } ```python BoxModelSpec.register_source(box, value=0.0) ``` Register an external source term for a box in automatic networks. The source is added directly to the box tendency. ``value`` may be a constant or a time-varying parameter-compatible object. ### register_state_variables { #climatecritters.BoxModelSpec.register_state_variables } ```python BoxModelSpec.register_state_variables(names) ``` Register prognostic state variables in integration order. ### register_tendency { #climatecritters.BoxModelSpec.register_tendency } ```python BoxModelSpec.register_tendency(state_variable, relation) ``` Register a callable tendency for one state variable. ``relation`` must accept a :class:`BoxModelContext` and return the tendency for ``state_variable``. ### register_transport { #climatecritters.BoxModelSpec.register_transport } ```python BoxModelSpec.register_transport(source, target, rate, rate_param=None) ``` Register a directed transport pathway. The transported mass flux is computed as ``rate * concentration(source)`` and removed from ``source`` while being added to ``target``. ### validate { #climatecritters.BoxModelSpec.validate } ```python BoxModelSpec.validate() ``` Validate that the spec is internally consistent.
